list.name: Alertas IoT
list.rawQuery:
from(bucket: "agro_iot_alerts")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_events")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "parcela", "variable", "severity", "_value"])

panels.title: Humedad del Suelo Actual — parcela_1 y parcela_3

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.title: Series de Tiempo — Temperatura y Humedad (últimas 6 horas)
Temperatura del Aire — 4 Parcelas

targets.query:
from(bucket: "agro_iot_processed")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_air")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
